status: frozen_before_model_fitting; archive-specific hashes bound by inventory command
population: Unambiguously unaged, all-NMC whole module experiments
rationale: R0 at each temperature supports later calibration; development covers R3/25C and R1/10C; reserve R3/10C, R1/40C and R3/40C. The first pilot is only 25C. No clean final-assessment 25C unaged run remains after quarantining row 32; do not claim independent final validation at 25C. Do not fit broad temperature dependence from 23C characterization alone.
cell_policy: Known-cell reconstruction conditional on pre-module characterization; cell identities recur across splits. This is not unseen-cell generalization. Do not use final module signals for fitting, sensor correction, threshold selection or design decisions.
final_access_policy: Inventory, hashes and cell-identity metadata only until model and acceptance criteria are locked. Audit CLI rejects final-assessment signal access.
change_policy: Any revision requires a new manifest version, reason and contamination assessment. Never move failed assessment runs to calibration silently.
